method: Pillow GaussianBlur on cropped ROI, pasted back only inside ROI; PNG RGB output
selection: Exploratory, based on historical performance and manual safety review; not a random benchmark sample.

excluded_after_visual_screen.reason: Pot shape obscured by plant/basket; cannot certify square/rectangular violation.
Transparent cup takes red/pink reflections; color-condition violation not unambiguous.
Tiny predicted ball against reference scoreboard; conservative exclusion from object-only/reference-preserving edit.
Coffee machine partly occluded by person; cannot isolate only the predicted object reliably.
Tray is rectangular; failure may be distance ranking, not a certified violated filter.
Tiny clock and image-center placement do not support reliable shape/position certification.
Light-object interpretation and target uniqueness not independently secure for a positive-control claim.

cohort_rules.wrong_verified_distractor: MCQ wrong, visible predicted object violates an explicit condition; no key-reference/target edit.
cohort_rules.correct_background_control: Originally joint correct; B/C are preselected non-key background regions, not failure-defined distractors. Never pool treatment-effect interpretation across cohorts.
